change_summary: Manual-only Torvik CBB and CFBD SP+ capture with an independent GitHub day claim before provider requests, schema and season checks, byte-exact encrypted archives and post-read observations. Adds a replay byte and cutoff gate and CI regression tests. No schedule, official model, risk, frozen v5 or market promotion changes.
assumptions: Torvik and CFBD are third-party sources; capture time proves when SportsEdge saw the bytes, not when the provider published them.
Torvik may refuse automated runner requests; that is recorded as BLOCKED.
Claim protection depends on artifact retention and operator non-deletion; direct local execution with opt-in does not use the GitHub day claim.
Validated field schemas and plausibility bands for team counts do not attest that any specific team universe is complete.
